observations.attempt: Exercised resolveMcpCredential across missing, malformed, revoked, expired, wrong-pepper, wrong-kind, and under-scoped (mismatched family) credentials for both GET/DELETE (unconditional 405, credential never inspected) and POST (every request requires deps.resolveCredential to succeed). Additionally analyzed the code-path shape of every rejection branch for a non-body/non-status/non-log side channel (timing).
evidence: router.get('/mcp') and router.delete('/mcp') return 405 unconditionally, never touching a credential (gateway.ts:317-321, unmodified).

router.post('/mcp') requires `credential = await deps.resolveCredential(bearerToken(req))` before any tool executes; a thrown McpKeyAuthenticationError maps uniformly to 401 (gateway.ts:282-291, unmodified).

mcpCredentialResolution.test.ts (this run, passed) proves: malformed tokens never reach the store (EC-5); wrong-family token/row combinations are rejected before any digest compare in both directions (EC-3); an unrecognized stored kind is rejected, never degraded to 'agent' (EC-4); wrong pepper version is rejected (EC-6); revoked is rejected (EC-7); deleted-issuer (createdBy null) is rejected (EC-8); and all of these produce byte-identical `McpKeyAuthenticationError('MCP authentication failed.')`.
ephemeralMcpGateway.test.ts (this run, passed) proves an expired ephemeral token and an entirely unknown one produce byte-identical HTTP status, body, and content-type at the gateway.

FINDING (timing, not covered by the above): resolveMcpCredential's rejection disjunction (mcpKeyService.ts:288-300) short-circuits BEFORE `mcpSecretHmac`/`hmacMatches` for every one of: unknown prefix, wrong family, revoked, expired, wrong pepper version, deleted issuer. Only a row that passes every one of those checks but has the WRONG SECRET reaches `await deps.getPepper()` + HMAC computation + `timingSafeEqual`. This is a measurable, pre-existing code-path-length asymmetry between "no such shape-valid row" and "shape-valid row, wrong secret" -- i.e. a timing side channel for row-shape-validity/existence, independent of the (correctly constant-time) secret comparison itself once reached. This predates CH-01 (the identical early-return structure already existed for mcp_live_ agent keys before this diff); CH-01's new `row.kind` clauses were added INTO the same short-circuiting disjunction, inheriting rather than introducing the gap for the new chat_ephemeral family. No empirical latency sampling was performed this run (STATIC code-path analysis only) -- see report Limitations.
